description:
SUMMARY 
 Support the design, development, and enhancement of a large-scale, Salesforce-based federal case management system. Work within an Agile team to build, test, and maintain platform functionality supporting a high-volume, mission-critical application; plan scalable, high-performance web system structures and select appropriate frameworks, cloud services, and APIs. Enforce coding guidelines, conduct code reviews, and set up testing frameworks for clean, maintainable code.
 
 ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES 
 · Design, develop, and maintain custom Salesforce solutions, including Apex classes, triggers, Lightning Web Components, and Flows.
 · Enhance and maintain the existing Salesforce platform to support millions of unique user accounts and high-volume concurrent usage.
 · Configure and customize Salesforce objects, workflows, validation rules, and page layouts to meet evolving business requirements.
 · Integrate Salesforce with external systems and third-party applications, including APIs and middleware.
 · Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and deployment activities using CI/CD pipelines.
 · Troubleshoot and resolve defects identified during testing and production operations.
 · Collaborate with business analysts, system engineers, and QA/test teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
 · Support release management and change control processes for platform updates.
 · Write complex or critical code, solve performance bottlenecks, and optimize database queries while identifying risks, redundancies, and outdated infrastructure, and planning updates and system security audits.
 · Maintain code, scripts, and configuration files in source control (GitHub Enterprise) per agency and industry standards, with traceability back to the originating Jira work item.
 · Support data models and dashboards and coordinate with technical personnel to resolve reporting and data issues.
 · Translate business and product requirements into clear technical specifications for the team.
 · Coordinate with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to align development with business objectives.
 · Responsible for conducting internal peer reviews and process audits prior to submissions.
 · Document business requirements, processes, procedures, meeting notes, and newly discovered requirements in Confluence, keeping the team's knowledge repository current and preventing knowledge silos.
 · Work in an Agile Scrum execution team to ensure all contract deliverables, program milestones, and reporting requirements are met in support of program objectives.
 · Maintain regular and punctual attendance.
 · Perform other duties as assigned.
 
 SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 None.
 Requirements 
 MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 
 · Must be able to meet and maintain eligibility requirements for a Public Trust position in accordance with Department of Commerce and OPM requirements. U.S. work authorization is required.
 · Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.Master's preferred.
 · Four (4) or more years of software-development experience across frontend and backend technologies.
 · Proven hands-on experience developing and configuring Salesforce applications (Apex, Visualforce, Lightning/LWC, SOQL).
 · Demonstrated expertise in designing overall web systems and choosing frameworks (like React, Vue, or Node.js).
 · Demonstrated knowledge of Agile / Scrum practices in a Government CI/CD environment.
 · Experience producing SOPs and technical documentation.
 · Must obtain and maintain any necessary security access and/or background checks.
 
 DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS 
 · Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 · Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced, high-availability production environment.
 · Experience modernizing legacy applications for cloud environments (AWS or Azure).
 · Experience with secure coding practices and automated security scanning in a CI/CD pipeline.
 · Experience with enterprise monitoring and incident response in a federal or regulated environment aligned to NIST standards.
 · Familiarity with the Department of Commerce, U.S. Census Bureau, or comparable federal financial, budget, or statistical-agency systems.
 · Salesforce certification(s) (e.g., Platform Developer I/II, Administrator) preferred.
 · Experience with Salesforce DevOps/release tools (e.g., Copado) a plus.
 
 WORK SCHEDULE 
 Full-time. May be required to work additional hours as needed to complete assignment or project.
 
 TRAVEL 
 The expected travel time is less than 15%.
 
 DRIVING REQUIREMENTS 
 Must have or be able to attain a valid state driver’s license and be insurable on the company’s automobile insurance policy. Driving, with or without accommodation, may be required when traveling for training and/or short occasional amounts of local driving. The expected driving time is less than 15%.
 
 WORK ENVIRONMENT 
 Work is expected to be remote; however, the company reserves the right to require onsite work.
 
 PHYSICAL DEMANDS 
 Position consists of sitting for long periods of time, bending, stooping, crouching, and lifting weights up to 20 pounds. Frequently uses hands/fingers for manipulation of keyboard and mouse. It is Katmai's business philosophy and practice to provide reasonable accommodations, according to applicable state and federal laws, to all qualified individuals with physical or mental disabilities.
 Benefits 
 Compensation & Benefits: 
 Pay: $90,000 - $100,000 annually
 Eligible Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life & AD&D Insurance, Long-Term & Short-Term Disability Insurance, 401(k) Savings Plan, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Vacation & Paid Personal Time, 11 Paid Federal Holidays, and Leave of Absence.
 
 Compliance: 
 To be considered for this position, all applicants must apply on the company website,  https://apply.workable.com/katmai/ 
 
 We are a VEVRAA Federal Contractor.
 
 We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, marital status, familial status or any other characteristic protected by law. 
 Preference will be given to Ouzinkie Shareholders, Descendants of Shareholders and Spouses of Shareholders in accordance with Title 43 U.S. Code 1626(g) and Title 42 U.S. Code 2000e - 2(i).
